blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur —Anti-narcotics operatives arrested a 40-year-old laborer in Pagadian City during a buy-bust operation on Saturday, netting around 100 grams of suspected shabu (crystal meth) worth P680,000. Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency-9 (PDEA-9) director Bryan Babang, in a statement, identified the suspect only as alias “Ben,” a resident of Barangay Bus-bus in Jolo, Sulu. Operatives from the PDEA Zamboanga del Sur Provincial Office apprehended the suspect after he allegedly sold two heat-sealed transparent plastic sachets containing suspected shabu to an undercover agent.
